name: Margin
description: Design system for the Kharcha research report. Source of truth for colour, type, grid, spacing, route geometry and motion. Edit this file, then run `npm run margin:tokens` to regenerate css/tokens.css.

paper.role: Page ground. Near-white, slightly warm; never pure white.
paper.basis: Reference page, corrected for photographic shading.

paper-deep.role: The only container fill. Used for genuine containment (tables, screenshot mounts), never for decoration.

route.role: The route line, its nodes, dashed breaks, margin notes and folios. Movement, events, intervention.
route.basis: Reference line, sampled rgb(201,76,60) and lifted for shading.

blue.role: Station labels (days, times), statistics, body copy. Time, evidence, participant voice.
blue.basis: Reference years and body copy, sampled rgb(52,102,135) median.

mustard.role: Chapter headlines and the single emphasis per spread. Insight.

ink.role: Artifacts: textured objects, stamps, screenshot keylines. Not used for running text.

stone.role: Data only: the neutral midpoint of a diverging scale, and 'no data' cells. Never text.
stone.basis: A grey between paper-deep and ink with no hue, so the midpoint reads as nothing.

blue-1.role: Data only: sequential ramp for magnitude (heat matrices, frequency). Light to dark, one hue.
blue-1.basis: Stepped from blue in lightness only.

blue-2.role: Data only: sequential ramp for magnitude (heat matrices, frequency). Light to dark, one hue.
blue-2.basis: Stepped from blue in lightness only.

blue-3.role: Data only: sequential ramp for magnitude (heat matrices, frequency). Light to dark, one hue.
blue-3.basis: Stepped from blue in lightness only.

blue-4.role: Data only: sequential ramp for magnitude (heat matrices, frequency). Light to dark, one hue.
blue-4.basis: Stepped from blue in lightness only.

blue-5.role: Data only: sequential ramp for magnitude (heat matrices, frequency). Light to dark, one hue.
blue-5.basis: Stepped from blue in lightness only.

display.role: Headlines, station labels, statistics, folios, tags. Always uppercase except statistics.
display.basis: Closest free match to the reference's geometric bold caps (R, S, 9 and 0 forms). Google Fonts, SIL OFL.

text.role: Body copy, quotes, margin notes, captions.
text.basis: Closest free match to the reference's light, low-contrast body serif. Google Fonts, SIL OFL.

display-xl.use: Chapter opener headline. One per chapter.

closing.use: Destination at the end of a route (reference: INTO THE FUTURE).

station.use: Day, date or time sitting in a break in the route. Horizontal or vertical.

stat.use: One figure that anchors a paragraph (reference: 99,98 %).

label.use: Chapter numbers, participant codes, tags, figure labels.

body.use: Running text. Short blocks of 3 to 7 lines that hug the route.

quote.use: Participant quote set as an object on the page.

note.use: Margin notes: researcher asides in a narrow column beside the route.

page.basis: A4 portrait pages read as spreads, like the reference book. Six columns per page give the route room to turn without every block sitting on a column.

space.basis: Every route turn, text inset and node gap is a multiple of 2mm, so loose compositions still align.

weight.basis: Reference line is about 1.7% of page width.

node.basis: Terminal dot is about 2.4 times the line weight in the reference.

radius.basis: Every turn is rounded. Radius is clamped to half the shorter segment.

break-gap.basis: Space between a node and the station label sitting in the break.

dash.basis: Dashed route: story interrupted or hypothesis.

dot.basis: Dotted route: the system relinquishing control (round caps on zero-length dashes).

hairline.basis: Leader lines from annotations to a precise point.

text-inset.basis: Minimum distance from route centre to text it encloses.

draw.use: Screen only: the route draws itself on first view.

node.use: A node appears as the line reaches it.

fade.use: Text beside a node fades in after the node.
